title: Tom Riddle's Diary
tagline: An enchanted diary that writes back
description: A two-person enchanted diary. One person writes on the page; the other opens the clasp with a PIN and answers from Tom's desk, and the reply inks itself into the diary. The real version syncs through Supabase; this demo keeps entries in your browser only.
controls: Write on the page · open the clasp with PIN 0000 to reply as Tom
